title: Pre-commit installer synopsis drift from implemented gate flow
description: Install-PreCommitHook synopsis/description text references only SIN scanning while generated hook executes additional gates, causing operator confusion and repeat rework.
detection_method: Targeted regex scan for stale synopsis phrase in Install-PreCommitHook script.
scan_regex: Install a git pre-commit hook that runs the SIN scanner against staged PS files
remediation: Keep synopsis and description aligned with generated hook behavior (secret scan, UI event scan, pre-commit gates).
examples:
# Stale phrase in comment help
Install a git pre-commit hook that runs the SIN scanner against staged PS files.
